fixVerification.narrowerClaimCheck: Ledger headline: 'cutover skips/reorders setHook leaving the default DefaultDispatchHook wired -> zero-debt mints'. INV3 and Halmos P1a/P1b/P1c/P1d test exactly that instance. M3 falsifies INV3 in the forge campaign and in the replay, and the replay was reproduced here. The fresh-DefaultDispatchHook bypass is a different scenario (a deliberate owner action, documented in story-051 and the NatSpec) and is parked as MR21-01, not hidden. P2b UNVERIFIED (killed) is correctly not cited, and _defaultHook is immutable. The passing tests prove the headline, not a narrower claim.

Ledger headline: unsynced donation absorbed by swap() strands non-dust phUSD or reverts on floors, for pool and quotePool. The code goes beyond the owner plan: pool syncs, and quotePool reads balances. INV1 (price-scaled tol plus a/1e12) is backed by the stricter INV1b, which has no relative term and also passes. The mock pair implements balance-(reserve-out) crediting but no feeTo, and that gap is closed by the 7/7 real-pair fork tests (reproduced here; donation zaps on both sides at a feeTo-on block). M1 and M2 each break their targets, with M1 also failing on Medusa. The run-20 PoC bit-rot is correctly reported as INCONCLUSIVE (MR21-06) and is not used as evidence.

The Q-19 title also mentions the dust pre-seed grief, but the owner's triageReason scopes Q-19 to the non-canonical pair and assigns the grief to L-24 (wont-fix). The fix matches the owner-confirmed plan verbatim (:220-221). Halmos P3a (IFF, with S3 non-vacuity) and P3b prove the check logic over axiomatized stubs, and fork test_fork_constructorRejectsNonCanonicalPair covers the real factory. The router_ trust root is parked as MR21-03 (Law 3).
The fix is a plan-doc change in phStaging2 (not landed at a309040). It is correctly classed as NOT-ADDRESSED, not as an INCOMPLETE FIX, and correctly not auto-closed.
